schedule.note: Proposed staggered 15-minute ticks; not a real-time guarantee. Default-branch workflow review required in both repositories.

controls.enable: Explicit repo-level opt-in variable, default off
controls.stop: Disable variable or workflow immediately; hard upper bound of four new synthetic versions (13-16) and one write per tick; no self-modification or automatic expansion
controls.permissions: Only reviewed workload may attest synthetic fixture and write own dedicated research state branch; no writes to main, no secrets or cross-repo write token
controls.identity: Verify repository ID/name, workflow path, trusted ref, expected reviewed code revision or explicit allowlist; transition from R9B identity approved separately
controls.state: Durable immutable records, deterministic writer parity, parent and previous record byte hash, verify all preceding attestations, no operation on missing peer record; CAS/no force push; repeated tick no-op
controls.failure: Fail closed on invalid attestation, fork, missing version, unexpected identity; record read-only receipt; no automatic merge; do not circumvent scheduler limits

exam: Real event=schedule runs after reviewed activation in both repos, not manual dispatch substitutes
At least two separate scheduled writer runs per node, four new versions, no interstitial operator commits
Missing peer tick/restart and duplicate retry must be exercised
Verify both final histories in read-only runner with explicit least privilege
Keep bounded trial separate from R7 repair and JFP production
implementation: Specification only; executable schedule/worker and approval not included in this PR.
